identity.title: Constraints on the Cosmic-Ray Ionization Rate in the z ∼ 2.3 Lensed Galaxies SMM J2135-0102 and SDP 17b from Observations of OH<SUP>+</SUP> and H<SUB>2</SUB>O<SUP>+</SUP>

paper_type_evidence.quote: we present observations of both molecules in absorption toward the lensed SMGs SMM J2135$-$0102 and SDP 17b.

question.value: What are the cosmic-ray ionization rates in lensed z~2.3 SMGs, inferred from OH+ and H2O+ absorption combined with a chemical model?

evidence.quote: Our goal is to infer the cosmic-ray ionization rate in SMGs at $z\sim2.3$ to better understand the impact of prolific star formation on the gas reservoirs in these massive galaxies
program ADS/JAO.ALMA#2016.1.00285.S: H$_2$O$^+$ at 1139 GHz in SMM J2135$-$0102 and SDP 17b.
programs ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.1.00175.S and ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.00569.S, respectively.
programs ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.1.00175.S and ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.00569.S, respectively.
are shifted down to frequencies covered by band 7 of ALMA.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: H2O+ 1139 GHz: three basebands, one window each, ~3000 km/s coverage; OH+ 1033 GHz: 2 basebands in upper sideband, 2500-3000 km/s; 31.25 MHz resolution (~30 km/s)

evidence.quote: A frequency resolution of 31.25 MHz provides velocity resolution of about 30 km s$^{-1}$.
the small synthesized beam used for the OH$^+$ observations (0.18$''$$\times$0.14$''$)

time_on_source.value: SDP 17b H2O+ 1481 s; SMM J2135 H2O+ 1451 s; SMM J2135 OH+ 3568 s; SDP 17b OH+ 1965 s

evidence.quote: SDP 17b was observed for 1481 s on 2016 Nov 26 targeting H$_2$O$^+$
SMM J2135$-$0102 was observed for 3568 s on 2014 Aug 19 targeting OH$^+$

what.value: CH+ column densities N(CH+)=(8.3±1.4)e14 and (4.7±1.9)e14 cm^-2 for SMM J2135-0102 and SDP 17b

evidence.quote: are reported as $N({\rm CH}^+)=(8.3\pm1.4)\times10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$ and $N({\rm CH}^+)=(4.7\pm1.9)\times10^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$, respectively
is about $X({\rm CH}^+)=7.6\times10^{-9}$ (cite: godard2014)
We adopt the mean value of $f_{\rm H_2}=0.053\pm0.026$ reported by (cite: indriolo2015oxy)

what.value: Chemical model grid of OH+ and H2O+ column densities

evidence.quote: We thus choose to employ the chemical models presented in (cite: neufeld2017)

simulations_or_models_as_data.value: Plane-parallel slab chemical models (Neufeld & Wolfire 2017) with Z=Zsun, nH=50 cm^-3, chi_UV=0.1-1000, 0.0003<=A_V<=8 mag, 9e-19<=zeta_H<=9e-15 s^-1

evidence.quote: we run the suite of chemical models using $\chi_{\rm UV}$=0.1, 1, 10, 100, and 1000

pipeline_or_manual.value: Calibration by NRAO staff using standard procedures

evidence.quote: All data calibration was performed by NRAO staff using standard procedures to produce calibrated measurement sets.
Further processing starting from those products was done with CASA version 5.0.0.
J2232+1143 as the bandpass calibrator, and Titan as the flux calibrator.

self_calibration.value: One round of phase-only self-cal on absorption-free continuum for all except OH+ in SMM J2135-0102

evidence.quote: One round of phase-only self-calibration using absorption-free portions of the continuum was applied to all observations (except for that covering OH$^+$ in SMM J2135$-$0102)
Measurement sets were imaged via the `clean` task in CASA
utilizing the Briggs weighting scheme with a robust parameter of 0.5
The analysis of (cite: neufeld2017), first presented by (cite: hollenbach2012), utilizes a chemical network designed specifically to focus on processes important to oxygen chemistry
The recent observations of CH$^+$ absorption in these galaxies are likely the best tracer of the same gas component giving rise to OH$^+$ and H$_2$O$^+$ absorption (cite: gerin2016).

unstated_but_needed: Cell size, image size, and channel width/spectral grid of the cubes
Clean threshold, masks, number of iterations
Self-calibration solution interval and continuum selection
Exact sub-region definitions (NW1-8, SE1-8, N/E/S/W) as apertures
Line-free region used for noise estimate
Model grid files and interpolation method for inferring zeta_H
Resulting zeta_H values per region (only ranges stated)

method.value: Clean with Briggs weighting, make PPV cubes; extract spectra from full source and sub-regions with CASA Viewer Spectral Profile Tool

evidence.quote: Spectra of the target galaxies were extracted from the data cubes using the Spectral Profile Tool within CASA Viewer.
a robust parameter of 0.5

validation.value: Mirrored NW/SE regions agree within noise

evidence.quote: the OH$^+$ and H$_2$O$^+$ absorption line profiles for the mirrored regions agree with each other within the noise levels

method.value: Normalize by moving average, tau=-ln(transmission), integrate over velocity ranges, convert to N via ground-state relation with constants 4.87e12 (1033 GHz) and 4.18e12 (1139 GHz)

evidence.quote: This is done by dividing the spectra by a moving average that was interpolated across velocities showing absorption or narrow emission.

assumptions.value: All hyperfine components at same frequency; CMB at z=2.3 (~9 K) does not populate excited states; H2O+ ortho-to-para = 3:1

evidence.quote: The *ortho*-to-*para* ratio expected based solely on statistical weights is 3:1, and we assume this value

validation.value: Uncertainties from continuum standard deviation propagated per channel; columns may be lower limits if absorption saturated

evidence.quote: Still, it is possible that these are only lower limits if saturated absorption is masked by the above effects.

method.value: N(H)=(1-f_H2) N(CH+)/X(CH+) with limiting X(CH+) values 2e-9 and 2e-8

evidence.quote: Uncertainties are dominated by the scatter in $X({\rm CH}^+)$ as we adopt the limiting values of $2\times10^{-9}$ and $2\times10^{-8}$ in our analysis.
We adopt the mean value of $f_{\rm H_2}=0.053\pm0.026$

analysis_steps.goal: Infer zeta_H from chemical model grids

method.value: Compare observed log N(OH+)/N(H) and N(OH+)/N(H2O+) to contours of constant zeta_H/n50 in model grids for several chi_UV/n50

evidence.quote: we plot contours of constant $\zeta_{\rm H}/n_{50}$ in the parameter space $\log_{10}[N({\rm OH}^+)/N({\rm H})]$ vs. $N({\rm OH}^+)/N({\rm H_2O}^+)$
so we use the chemical models with $Z=Z_\ensuremath{\odot}$ in our analysis

assumptions.value: Metallicity solar; absorption arises in extended low-density halo

evidence.quote: Metallicities in submillimeter galaxies at $z\sim2$ have been estimated to be roughly solar

validation.value: Compared with Galactic diffuse clouds and earlier zeta estimates

evidence.quote: occupy the same location in $\log_{10}[N({\rm OH}^+)/N({\rm H})]$ vs. $N({\rm OH}^+)/N({\rm H_2O}^+)$ parameter space as Galactic diffuse clouds

used_for.value: Imaging (clean), self-calibration, spectral extraction with Viewer

evidence.quote: Further processing starting from those products was done with CASA version 5.0.0.
cosmic-ray ionization rates on the order of 10$^{-16}$–10$^{-14}$ s$^{-1}$ in the extended gaseous halos

findings_qualitative.value: OH+ and H2O+ absorption profiles vary with position and show velocity gradients in SMM J2135-0102 consistent with rotation; none in SDP 17b

evidence.quote: shifting to larger velocities with increasing distance from the critical curve.

claims.hypothesis: OH+ and H2O+ are detectable in absorption in z~2.3 lensed SMGs with ALMA
claims.result: Both molecules detected in both galaxies

evidence.quote: Both molecules are detected, and their absorption profiles change with position in front of the background continuum sources.

claims.hypothesis: Cosmic-ray ionization rates in SMG halos can be constrained
claims.experiment: Column densities with chemical models and N(H) from CH+
claims.finding: Rates in compact star-forming regions likely orders of magnitude higher

evidence.quote: they imply that cosmic-ray ionization rates in the compact regions where star formation occurs in these galaxies are orders of magnitude higher.

why_this_method.value: Analytic steady-state expressions invalid at high zeta and require unconstrained parameters, so full chemical models used

evidence.quote: removing the need to adopt unconstrained values of $x_e$ and $\epsilon$.
those expressions are only valid over a limited range of physical conditions

limitations_admitted.value: Column densities may be lower limits due to saturation; N(H) highly uncertain; mismatched beams

evidence.quote: any estimate of the hydrogen column density from CH$^+$ will be highly uncertain

referee_caveats_inferred: N(H) from CH+ with Galactic X(CH+) is very uncertain
Final zeta_H rests on poorly known UV field and density
Beam mismatch between OH+, H2O+ and CH+
Quantitative zeta_H per region not tabulated

data_public_as_stated.value: Archival ALMA data cited by project code

evidence.quote: Observations covering the 1033 GHz transition in both target galaxies are publicly available in the ALMA archive.

reproducibility.score_reason: Data are public and column density steps are described, but model grids, apertures and imaging details are missing and zeta_H is read graphically.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Column densities are reproducible, but the main zeta_H result relies on external model grids and graphical reading.
